name: TVG_SQMM_benchmark_v1
description: A multimodal benchmark (TVG_SQMM v1) designed to evaluate text-video (and possibly audio) grounding, query matching, and quality of multimodal matching models. It measures how well models retrieve or localize relevant video segments given textual queries and ranks candidate matches by relevance. Tasks emphasize alignment between modalities and retrieval/precision of matches.
evaluation_method: Recall@k and mAP (mean average precision) for retrieval/localization
reputation: A relatively small/targeted Hugging Face benchmark with limited visibility outside its contributor community.
